info.title: Gerenuk Marketing API
info.description:
Manage contacts, lists, custom fields and events in a workspace.

Every request needs a workspace API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A token carries permissions; each operation says which one it needs. Requests are limited per token each minute.

Request bodies are flat JSON. A record comes back inside `data`. Lists are cursor-paginated: pass `per_page` and `cursor`, and follow `meta.next_cursor` until it is null. Errors have a stable `code` and a `message`, and 422 adds `errors` keyed by field. A 429 response includes a `Retry-After` header.

get.description: The workspace this token belongs to, and the token's name and permissions. Works with any valid token, so it is a cheap way to check a token.

401.description: Unauthenticated. The token is missing, invalid or expired.

429.description: Too many requests. Either the token exceeded its per-minute limit, or the caller's IP sent too many invalid tokens.

get.description:
Requires a token with the `contacts.view` permission.

Contacts in ID order, 100 per page by default. Follow `meta.next_cursor` (pass it as `cursor`) to read the next page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only contacts with this status: `subscribed` or `unsubscribed`.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Only contacts on the list with this ID.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only contacts with the tag with this ID.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Only contacts in the segment with this ID. An unknown ID answers 404.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: When true, list only archived contacts. By default only active contacts are listed.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches against email address, first name and last name.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Contacts per page, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `meta.next_cursor` value from the previous page.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

next_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the next set of items.

prev_cursor.description: The "cursor" that points to the previous set of items.

422.description: A filter failed validation, such as an unknown `status`.

404.description: The `segment` filter names a segment that does not exist.

put.description:
Requires a token with the `contacts.manage` permission.

Create or update a contact. Custom fields are merged; tags and lists are added, never removed.
Someone who unsubscribed is only subscribed again when `resubscribe` is true.

Answers `201` with the new contact when this call created it, and `200` with the updated contact when it already existed.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The contact's email address, URL-encoded. Matched case-insensitively: it is trimmed and lowercased before lookup.

status.description: Whether the contact is subscribed. See `resubscribe` for turning an unsubscribed contact back on.

custom_fields.description: Values keyed by custom field key. The accepted keys are defined per workspace; list them with `GET /custom-fields`. Unknown keys are rejected. Merged into the contact's existing values.

tags.description: Tag names to add, at most 50, each at most 100 characters. Tags are never removed by this call.

lists.description: IDs of lists to add the contact to. Lists are never removed by this call, and each ID must belong to this workspace.

resubscribe.description: Set to true to subscribe someone who previously unsubscribed. Without it their status is left as it is.

200.description: The contact already existed and was updated.

post.description:
Requires a token with the `contacts.manage` permission.

Records a named event on a contact's timeline and starts any automations triggered by it. The event is processed asynchronously, so this answers `202`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send the same key when retrying. A repeat within the workspace returns the original response and records nothing new. Must be 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters.

properties.description: Free-form data about the event, such as an order total. Available to automations that this event triggers.

create_contact.description: Set to true to create the contact when no contact has this email. Otherwise an unknown email answers 404.

202.description: Accepted. `data` is the recorded event; a repeated request with the same `Idempotency-Key` answers with the original event.

404.description: No contact with that email, and `create_contact` was not true.

422.description: The body failed validation, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is not 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters (then `message` says so and `errors` is absent).
